title: English lab briefs and fully annotated solutions beneath each task
contract: Read current authoritative source notebook/Word-derived LAB.md and linked owner demo code before writing any English assignment; do not infer unseen Word content.
Present each original task as clear English, preserving numbers, datasets, instructions and discrepancies. Mark headings reconstructed from notebook code as reconstructed, not a verbatim translation.
Immediately beneath EACH English task place its explained solution, with fully commented Python including purpose, imports, functions, parameters, intermediate steps, output/edge cases.
Use owner demo/scripts and existing valid reference SOLUTION.py where applicable; never copy known buggy demonstration behavior without correction and explanation.

Export each lab into docs/labs/<lab-slug>/ with LAB_EN_SOLVED.md and runnable SOLUTION_ANNOTATED.py (and README.md if useful); existing labs/pythoclass remain source references, do not alter source repo.
For new Math labs also create source-linked folders under labs/pythoclass with LAB.md, DEMO.py or SOURCE_NOTEBOOK.md, KNOWLEDGE.md and SOLUTION.py, without fabricated original Word documents.
Use synthetic data and avoid copying private identities from source. Preserve factual source requirements; explain unknown constraints rather than guessing.
Run head-specific GitHub Actions tests of all new exports plus baseline curriculum and preserve the 46 lessons / 920 MCQs. For each batch, one PR, final HEAD CI SUCCESS before merge.
Store progress, exact source sha, changed files, PR, CI and caveats in a ledger; do not mark COMPLETE without checks. Stop new batch until previous merged.
Windows Bridge/PowerShell and CDP 9224 validation remains UNVERIFIED absent real worker proof; no duplicate Bridge task/ACK or automatic new goal after completion.
